profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Accomplished and well-versed Senior Full Stack Engineer with over 13 years of full lifecycle experience in scoping, designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale business applications and business intelligence software. Adept at leading the design, implementation, testing, debugging, and maintenance of web-based software applications, ensuring compliance with stringent time and budget constraints.

Exceptional problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with a unique ability to translate complex business challenges into technical solutions. Proven expertise in technical leadership, cross-functional coordination, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring seamless project execution and optimal user experiences.

Highly proficient in multi-tasking across diverse technical environments, with extensive experience in a broad range of applications, frameworks, and hardware platforms. A results-driven professional with a track record of delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions, driving business growth, and spearheading customer support initiatives.

positions.title: Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · NestJS · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Tailwind CSS · MongoDB · Vue.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React Native · HTML · jQuery · Next.js · Express.js · Node.js · Bootstrap (Framework) · Python (Programming Language) · Dart · Web Scraping · Flutter

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained a legacy architecture for data warehousing, business intelligence, and backend APIs.
- Designed, developed, and maintained a new architecture for data warehousing, business intelligence, and backend APIs with AWS data lake, AWS lambda, Snowflake, and Laravel.
- Designed and developed solutions for various technical problems that have occurred in data warehousing, business intelligence, and backend APIs.
- Optimized time and space complexity for the legacy and the new architectures.
- Designed, developed, and maintained various modular components with OOP principles to be reusable, testable, and extendible.
- Led a team by developing and improving naming conventions, coding standards, and unit testing protocols.
- Mentored newly hired engineers and created a set of training exercises to support their onboarding
- Collaborated on the architecture of a set of microservices, migrating from multiple monolithic applications, enabling feature sharing, reducing development time, and expediting onboarding, among other benefits
- Designed the database schema for each microservice, focusing on scalability and flexibility
- Crafted RESTful APIs with backwards compatibility, versioning, integration tests, and unit tests
- Integrated multiple enterprise applications including PayPal, iTunes, Google Play, and Paymentech
- Developed a unified Customer Support API that integrated with Zendesk and several of our products
- Set up containerized development environments using Docker
- Worked on accounts’ management & billing, PII obfuscation, A/B testing, and campaign attribution 
- Coordinated with IT and DevOps on production and development solutions
- Set up application alerts & monitoring, utilizing services such as DataDog & Sentry.io 
- Adapted in a rapidly growing company, providing education to millions of children
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · jQuery · Bootstrap (Framework) · Snowflake · Python (Programming Language) · Selenium

positions.title: Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- SnapLook began as an app for sharing daily outfits and receiving feedback. It later pivoted to a browser extension focused on visual product combinations, saving, and sharing.
- Developed the app using Ionic for client-side, and Laravel on LAMP stack for server-side.
- After pivot, developed the service using HTML, CSS, JS for client-side, and Laravel on LAMP stack for server-side.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React Native · HTML · jQuery · Bootstrap (Framework) · Selenium · Web Scraping · Flutter

positions.title: Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Shoppyst was a web-based social media service designed for users to share their favorite products, create collections, and inspire others.
- Developed the service using Laravel on LAMP stack.
positions.insights: Skills: Ionic Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · jQuery · Bootstrap (Framework) · AngularJS

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and maintained various enterprise applications such as sales channel adviser, warehouse management system, customer management system, ERP system, and etc.
- Designed applications using OO methodologies to create extensible / reusable / maintainable software.
- Developed applications using MVC pattern with PHP frameworks ( Laravel, CodeIgniter ) on LAMP stack.
- Designed and developed REST APIs for secure communications between systems.
- Designed and developed Integrating solutions for external data from various back-end services and databases which have different formats and protocols.
- Maintained and updated applications with the latest technologies.
- Designed, developed, and maintained approximately 30 e-commerce websites, catering to the needs of small to large companies.
- Designed, developed, and maintained various web and mobile applications such as social networking service, social sweepstakes, and etc.
- Developed applications with Ionic framework, node.js, Cordova/Phonegap, AngularJS, HTML5, CSS/SASS, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap.
- Tested responsiveness and cross browser compatibility using Selenium.
- Designed and improved UI / UX with user feedback for great user experiences.
- Led and managed team to work in a rapid release production environment with Agile & SCRUM methodologies.
- Led the team to be passionate in discussions with teammates and letting the best ideas rise to the top.
- Provided strong technical leadership, focus on continuous improvement.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · Smarty · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · jQuery · Bootstrap (Framework) · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)
